THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 13 · Starry cavern
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Your light scatters across a ceiling that glitters like a field of stars. Below it stand two battered stone buildings, blackened by fire, amid the fallen dead.

Points of light prick the ceiling above the two blackened buildings. Down below, fallen bodies and scorched stone tell a harsher story. The buildings interrupt the open cavern, each offering a closer approach and a separate interior to examine.

Ask the players

Do you inspect the stone, examine the buildings, or look for the source of the lingering magic?
